title: Quest for Zeus's Master Bolt
objective: Retrieve Zeus's stolen Master Lightning Bolt from the Underworld before the Summer Solstice to prevent a cataclysmic war among the Big Three.
outcome: Successful; Master Bolt recovered from Ares's backpack and returned to Zeus on Mount Olympus; Helm of Darkness restored to Hades.
initiated_by: Chiron and Oracle of Delphi (under ultimatum from Zeus)
description: Percy Jackson's foundational quest across America accompanied by Annabeth Chase and Grover Underwood to recover Zeus's stolen weapon.

title: Quest for the Golden Fleece
objective: Retrieve the Golden Fleece from Polyphemus's island in the Sea of Monsters to heal Thalia's poisoned pine tree and rescue Grover.
outcome: Successful; Fleece recovered and brought back to Camp Half-Blood, curing the tree and unexpectedly resurrecting Thalia Grace.
initiated_by: Tantalus (official authorization) / Hermes (unofficial spur for Percy)
description: Voyage into the Bermuda Triangle to rescue Grover Underwood and retrieve the Golden Fleece to save Camp Half-Blood.

title: Quest to Rescue Artemis and Annabeth
objective: Travel west to locate and rescue the captured goddess Artemis and Annabeth Chase, and confront the Titan Atlas.
outcome: Successful rescuing of Artemis and Annabeth, but with fatal casualties (Bianca di Angelo and Zoë Nightshade killed).
description: Cross-country search mission led by Zoë Nightshade to save Artemis and Annabeth from Mount Tamalpais.

title: Quest into the Labyrinth
objective: Navigate Daedalus's subterranean Labyrinth to locate Daedalus, secure Ariadne's Thread, and prevent Kronos's army from invading Camp Half-Blood.
outcome: Partially successful; Ariadne's Thread secured by Luke's forces but Daedalus sacrificed himself to collapse the Labyrinth following the Battle of Camp Half-Blood.
initiated_by: Annabeth Chase via the Oracle of Delphi
description: Perilous subterranean expedition led by Annabeth Chase through the living Labyrinth.

title: Quest for Ares's Stolen Chariot
objective: Recover Ares's war chariot from his antagonistic sons Phobos and Deimos in Brooklyn before sunset.
outcome: Successful; Phobos and Deimos defeated and war chariot safely returned to Ares.
description: Short-notice emergency quest undertaken by Clarisse and Percy in New York City.

title: Quest for the Bronze Dragon
objective: Reassemble and reactivate the magical Bronze Dragon automaton hidden in Camp Half-Blood's woods to rescue Beckendorf from Myrmekes.
outcome: Successful; Bronze Dragon reassembled, Myrmekes nest defeated, and Beckendorf rescued.
description: Camp-based rescue mission in the Woods during a game of Capture the Flag.

title: Quest for the Sword of Hades
objective: Recover Hades's newly forged Stygian Iron keys/sword stolen by Ethan Nakamura and Iapetus before it leaves the Underworld.
outcome: Successful; Titan Iapetus defeated and washed in the River Lethe, sword recovered and delivered to Persephone.
description: Underworld mission uniting children of the Big Three (Percy, Thalia, Nico) to retrieve a secret divine weapon.

title: Quest for the Singer of Apollo
objective: Recapture Apollo's runaway golden Celedon automaton in Times Square before his divine concert on Mount Olympus.
outcome: Successful; Celedon pacified with musical spell and returned to Apollo.
description: Emergency Manhattan mission assigned by Apollo to Percy and Grover on Grover's birthday.

title: Quest of Perseus for Medusa's Head
objective: Retrieve the severed head of the Gorgon Medusa to prevent King Polydectes from forcibly marrying Danaë.
outcome: Successful; Medusa decapitated using Athena's shield and Hermes's harpe, and Polydectes petrified upon Perseus's return.
description: Mythic hero quest of Perseus across the ancient world using divine gifts to slay Medusa.

title: Quest of Theseus to Slay the Minotaur
objective: Travel to Crete as a tribute, enter King Minos's Labyrinth, and slay the Minotaur to free Athens from human sacrifice.
outcome: Successful; Minotaur slain in single combat and Theseus navigated out of the Labyrinth using Ariadne's Thread.
description: Classical hero quest of Theseus entering the Cretan Labyrinth to destroy Asterion the Minotaur.

title: Twelve Labors of Heracles
objective: Complete twelve impossible tasks assigned by King Eurystheus to expiate the murder of his family under Hera's madness.
outcome: Successful; all twelve labors completed, securing Heracles's eventual divine ascension to Mount Olympus.
description: Monumental epic quest sequence comprising twelve labors across ancient Greece, the Underworld, and the ends of the Earth.

title: Quest of Bellerophon for Pegasus and the Chimera
objective: Tame the winged horse Pegasus with Athena's golden bridle and slay the fire-breathing Chimera terrorizing Lycia.
outcome: Successful; Chimera choked with a lead-tipped spear and Bellerophon rewarded by King Iobates.
description: Mythic hero quest of Bellerophon riding Pegasus to slay the Chimera.
